principle: A new module or passing test does not by itself complete an operational/empirical acceptance check. Engineering completion and profitability are distinct.

completed.title: Repository inventory
completed.basis: Tracked script/file inventory; current counts verified from Git metadata.

completed.title: JavaScript syntax coverage
completed.basis: Exact-source CI parses every root/tool JS module without executing it.

completed.title: Authority and research-preservation map
completed.basis: Every972 baseline blob classified; actual protected data/modes checked and policy enforced; owner/activation faults rejected.

completed.title: Workflow inventory and parsing
completed.basis: Inherited verified inventory and accepted current branch workflow definitions; not operational certification.

completed.basis: Prior verified workflow save-list regression and repair preserved.

completed.title: Exact-commit push/PR/safety CI
completed.basis: Exact source checks independently verified for published milestones; failed attempts retained.

completed.title: Timestamp/materiality boundaries
completed.basis: Prior bounded source review and explicit source-time versus ingestion distinctions preserved.

completed.title: Chronology/malformed numeric regressions
completed.basis: Prior chronology and finite/noncoerced evidence fixes verified; thresholds/frozen verdicts preserved.

completed.basis: Current valid owner yes/exclusions required; inherited regression evidence preserved.

completed.basis: Rejected/stale states persist until valid owner recheck; no third-party auto-approval.

completed.title: Malformed/missing/stale ZAD integration
completed.basis: Shared policy and bot fault fixtures preserve fail-closed owner state.

completed.title: Finite-quote overflow safeguards
completed.basis: Overflow-safe spread arithmetic and quote clock regressions verified.

completed.title: Order endpoint/default-off paper mutation audit
completed.basis: Prior endpoint/permission mapping and opt-in paper-only transport tests preserved; no orders executed.

completed.title: ACK/failure/cap/mute baseline
completed.basis: Prior acknowledgment and cap/mute tests retained; later journal/news repairs do not close all paths.

completed.title: Shared transport timeout/429/length/retry policy
completed.basis: Shared facade preserves explicit ACKs, bounded 429 handling and no ambiguous automatic replay.

completed.title: Baseline automated regression suite
completed.basis: Inherited baseline test results retained, not reclassified as profitability.

completed.title: Post-repair automated/integration suites
completed.basis: Exact-source full suites plus watcher/delivery/research/preservation fixtures pass; no local run claimed after workspace loss.

completed.title: Frozen experiment/holdout metadata registry
completed.basis: 747 registered IDs and51 source-study snapshots audited as metadata; no historical replay/performance certification.

completed.title: Frozen ignition result scope
completed.basis: Prior artifact review distinguishes partial two-year minute evidence from five-year daily studies; rejected variants preserved.

completed.title: All-path fail-closed execution fault injection
completed.requiredVerification: Inject errors/timeouts/redirects/config ambiguity/duplicate or resumed jobs on every mutation path. Prove no live broker host, method override or default opt-in mutation; unknown outcomes do not trigger blind retries. No actual order is needed or authorized.
completed.basis: All currently wired broker routes inventoried and fault-injected through actual adapter/composed private CAS protocol. Default off, PAPER-only, strict schemas, remote intent+ACK, account quarantine across client IDs, races/restarts, timeouts/redirects/refusals and no blind retry verified. No actual broker/private write or deployment required or performed.
completed.remainingLimit: Future new routes must extend the matrix. Actual order approval, migration, fills, plan evidence and profits remain separate.

remaining.title: Behavioral review of every script
remaining.requiredVerification: Per-script input/output/side-effect, failure, timing and research-boundary review with linked evidence; targeted regressions for defects. Inventory/syntax alone cannot close this.

remaining.title: All workflow failure/write/concurrency semantics
remaining.requiredVerification: Per-workflow and helper review of checkout/ref, writes, retries, conflict handling, concurrency, secrets, failure saving and retention. Real disposable-Git conflict/retry tests for repaired publication paths. No production dispatch.

remaining.title: Actual provider entitlements and coverage
remaining.requiredVerification: Official provider account/plan/endpoint coverage plus authorized observed permission/refusal responses. Distinguish IEX/SIP/extended-hours and missing subscriptions; no purchases or exposed credentials.
remaining.partialEvidence: Owner-confirmed Massive Starter15minute delay; authorized actual SIP/IEX endpoint samples and official SDK symbol-request contract. Alpaca account contract/full universe still unverified.

remaining.title: All-provider symbol/session normalization
remaining.requiredVerification: Inventory every provider symbol format, field units/clocks, exchange/session and corporate-action normalization; ambiguous aliases fail closed. Test representative preferred/share classes, ticker changes, DST/half days, missing/future/stale fields across actual ingress paths.
remaining.partialEvidence: Independent clock/provider/feed repairs and explicit-universe offline session contracts; all-provider audit remains open.

remaining.title: Measured full-session freshness and latency
remaining.requiredVerification: Authorized observed full regular/premarket/half-day sessions with every intended minute, received/verified-universe denominators, BBO/trade/volume clocks, p95 latency, outages and last-success telemetry. Fixtures and job status cannot close this.

remaining.title: Whole-market premarket discovery verified
remaining.requiredVerification: Old Massive-delayed Phase A is not valid real-time proof. Separately review/implement/pin revised explicit-universe SIP hybrid collector, budget and encrypted recovery, then obtain exact dated approval and measure actual broad coverage. Offline330-minute fixtures are not live evidence.

remaining.title: Prospective matched lead/false-positive evaluation
remaining.requiredVerification: Pre-registered period/hypotheses/end date and minimum independent cases/days; first detection before observed+5/+10/+20/+25, executable quotes/control/benchmark, unresolved misses, costs, displayed size, drawdowns and clustered uncertainty. Actual cases currently0; no tuning/optional stopping.

remaining.title: All-source ingestion and deduplication
remaining.requiredVerification: Source-by-source event identity, publication/ingestion clocks, stale/future/broken payloads, duplicate/revised stories, threat/materiality truthfulness and persistence across jobs. Include conflicting/missing source evidence.

remaining.title: Independent point-in-time catalyst/missing-source audit
remaining.requiredVerification: Independently sourced contemporaneous filings/news/events, economic publication versus access timestamps, missing-source denominators and late-ingestion/missed-runner attribution. Current caches cannot authenticate past availability.

remaining.title: Every approved recommendation and cached-render path
remaining.requiredVerification: Enumerate all current BUY/entry/action channels, monthly/basket/owner lanes, options, callbacks and cached reports. With missing/stale/expired/rejected/malformed/third-party marks, prove no approved BUY; test valid owner yes separately. Catalyst/cache repairs alone are partial.
remaining.partialEvidence: Catalyst, cached leaders and rebalancing ADD owner gates repaired; remaining core/monthly/basket/options/callback/report paths still require full matrix.

remaining.title: Cross-lane entry/stop/gap/cost consistency
remaining.requiredVerification: Compare every delivered plan to its registered tested entry/stop/exit/hold/cost/risk specification. Explicitly separate changed safety variants from original results; validate finite prices, opening gaps, no-price cases, sizing, realistic fees/slippage and liquidity.

remaining.title: All send paths, stable IDs and cross-job durability
remaining.requiredVerification: Inventory every message and callback route; stable logical IDs, partial-message ACKs, unknown/reserved quarantine, confirmed persistence and safe reconciliation across independent jobs. Integrate reviewed journal where appropriate; no silent permission additions. Current journal is opt-in, not enabled globally.
remaining.partialEvidence: Basket intent/ACK/quarantine repaired on branch; remote journal still opt-in, all-route delivery/persistence not complete.

remaining.title: Authorized actual non-BUY delivery validation
remaining.requiredVerification: After readiness review and explicit owner approval, prove a bounded non-sensitive non-BUY notification and independent run/recovery deduplication with real acknowledgments. No live BUY or trade permitted; mock contracts do not close this.

remaining.title: Independent realistic after-cost replay
remaining.requiredVerification: Source-audited point-in-time universe including delistings, registered untouched holdout, next executable entry/exit, fees/spreads/liquidity/stress and consistent price basis. Separate corrected evidence from frozen firstRun; rejected outcomes retained.

remaining.title: Actual identity/ticker/delisting/survivorship audit
remaining.requiredVerification: Independent security-level mappings at decision/entry/exit and as-known universe membership, ticker/class changes and documented terminal values. Admission shape/fixture checks do not authenticate sources or universe completeness.

remaining.title: All performance claims and windows validated
remaining.requiredVerification: Catalogue each user-facing numerical/tested/proven/unseen claim, exact source/selection window, cost/hold basis and coverage. Authenticate/reproduce with separate audited evidence where possible; qualify unsupported claims without rewriting frozen results.

remaining.title: Benchmark/capacity/drawdown/uncertainty report
remaining.requiredVerification: Observed candidate/control/SPY paths and realistic costs, quote sizes/liquidity, censored gaps, adverse selection/capacity and drawdowns; predeclared clustered uncertainty/multiple-comparison rules and untouched confirmation. Quote-model fixtures alone cannot establish profitability.
